item.title: Mitsubishi Colt 1100 and 1000F Deluxe (1966)
item.description:
Publication: Motor Fan
Format: Road Test
Date: December 1966
Authors (roundtable): Yukichi Mochida, Sadao Kobayashi, Osamu Hirao, Yasutaka Toyoshima, Hachiro Utsumi, Yasuhei Oguchi, Kazuo Kumabe, Katsuyuki Miura, Taizo Tateishi, Kenji Higuchi, Mineo Yamamoto, Chiaki Moritani, Kenzaburo Ishikawa, Minoru Onda, Isao Imai, Toshihide Hirata, Mitsuo Nakao, Motor Fan Editorial Staff (uncredited)

Mitsubishi’s Vision for the 1000cc Class

Magazine: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries now has a passenger-car range extending from the 360cc minicar class all the way up to 2000cc. Could you begin by telling us about the thinking behind the newly introduced Colt 1100, and how it fits into Mitsubishi’s overall plans?

item.title: Mitsubishi Colt 1200 Deluxe (1968)
item.description:
Publication: Motor Fan
Format: Test Drive Report
Date: July 1968
Authors: Yasuhei Oguchi, Kenji Higuchi

More Than the Extra 100cc Suggests: Pointing the Way for the Family Car (Yasuhei Oguchi)

The Colt series has a long history as a family car, and the newly announced Colt 1200 is a high-performance model worthy of a well–established name in the 1000cc class. Particularly in terms of engine performance, the 1100 that replaced the Colt 1000 in September 1966 has had its capacity increased by a further 100cc, providing greater reserves of acceleration at high speeds.
